evidence.title: High-Speed Optical Connectors for Datacenter Interconnect: Market Overview 2025-2026
evidence.summary: Analysis of optical connector supply for datacenter AI infrastructure. MPO and LC-style connectors are critical interface for fiber-to-module routing. Major suppliers include CommScope, Amphenol, and others. Amphenol provides high-precision optical connectors (MPO 8x/12x) with insertion loss <0.3dB for datacenter transceiver modules and interconnect backplanes.
evidence.excerpt: Amphenol's optical connector products serve datacenter optical transceiver modules and backplane interconnect applications, competing with CommScope and Corning in the broader optical infrastructure market.

evidence.title: High-Speed Electrical Connectors for AI Module Interconnect: Supplier Landscape 2025
evidence.summary: Market analysis of high-speed differential connectors (100+ Gbps) for AI accelerator module-to-module and chassis routing. Key suppliers include TE Connectivity, Amphenol, and Harting. Amphenol supplies controlled-impedance connectors with gold-plated contacts and low-profile designs for dense GPU cluster layouts.
evidence.excerpt: Amphenol manufactures high-speed electrical connectors for AI infrastructure applications, including module-level interconnect and backplane routing in datacenter environments.

evidence.title: Redriver and Signal Conditioning Chiplets for Datacenter Interconnect: Architecture and Supply 2025
evidence.summary: Technical analysis of low-power redriver and buffer chiplets used for signal regeneration in high-speed backplane and module-to-module links (100-112 Gbps lanes). Marvell Technology produces redriver and signal-conditioning chiplets for datacenter applications, competing with Microchip and other vendors in this segment.
evidence.excerpt: Marvell manufactures redriver chiplets for datacenter and AI infrastructure high-speed interconnect, supporting long-reach backplane routing within chassis at competitive power levels.
